description: [phase 3.8 38f, kind `gate`] Gate (f) as written ("8,192 TIME-FORWARD frames from a course_season image with no input") has no instance in the original: with no input the game blocks in input-gated modal waits. (1) mainLoop 0x0041e283: when [0x004c2e0c] != -1 (read at 0x0041e253) it plays sound 0x95, refreshes the window and waits in pumpAndRedraw(0) until a click or key; from course_season/00's image the port stops there after 1,426 frames (frame 1,593 since boot), and course_season's own trace shows the original waiting 440 virtual ms in that frame (clock sites 0x0045c0cc / 0x0045c0e5) until the recorded Esc. (2) showEndOfYearScreen 0x0044cff0 runs at every year end (g_date a multiple of 8,192) and its loop ends only on a left click or a key (log/p38/38c_notes.md); every 8,192-frame window contains a year end. Measured instead: the longest no-input stretch (course_season/03's image, 6,188 frames up to the year end) and recorded-input runs of 8,192 frames and more (course_season_6y).
path to resolution: the user accepts the two measurements as gate (f), or names an input policy for the waits (for example an Esc at each Blocking pump) under which "no input" is meant

description: [phase 3.8 38f, kind `interface`] The semantic command kinds 0x100..0x106 (portsim/sim/commands.h) carry only the click handler's effect after its hit test. A recorded press reaching clickGolferPanel (H2 call at 0x0041e48c) also runs mainLoop H2's own press code: g_cachedCameraTileX = -1 (0x0041e3b1), screenToTile of the click, the button word [g_rootInput+0x10] cleared (0x0041e49a), and the return to the frame head when the handler returns <= 0 (0x0041e4a0). Measured on championship/00 with only the first shot-style click replaced by GolferPanelAction(4) (hit test hitGolferPanel435f00(415, 508) on the state the original call saw): the run diverges at the next frame head (record 178) in g_cachedCameraTileX (-1 recorded, 0x19 semantic) and g_frameMs (1 recorded, 0 semantic). Keys (Esc 0x1b, 'X', 'Z' in championship/02) and the aim presses that no click handler takes have no semantic kind at all: 131 of the 145 recorded dispatches of championship/00..02 have no translation on the merged build of 2026-10-20 02:38 (the other 14 are the 7 translated presses and their 7 mouse-downs; on HEAD, where championship/02 stopped at showHoleStatsScreen, 133 and 6 + 6). The same divergence follows every first translated press: championship/01 at record 130, championship/02 at record 250.
path to resolution: a frame-level semantic layer (a press command applied at H2's press point with its hit test decided, plus key commands for H1's key switch), or presses kept as RootHandler commands for a headless driver

description: [phase 3.8 38f, kind `evidence`] chooseShotTarget.strictFlagSticky (model_defects#37) has no segment or test in which turning it OFF changes a result: all 200 accepted segments give the same digest with it OFF (log/p38/38f/defects_x64.tsv for 190, log/p38/38f/defects_x64_cs6y.json for the 50,914 frames of course_season_6y), port/test/test_shots.py::test_defects_the_vectors_cannot_see asserts the 12 vectors do not change, and 480 mutated inputs of those vectors (golfer prefs bit 2 set, unk_005a9cc4 0 / 1 / 3, g_difficulty 0..3, strokes 0..3) gave equal results ON and OFF. The strict flag is set only in a pass with trials == 4, prefs bit 2, unk_005a9cc4 != 2, outOfReach == 0 and a landing level <= 0; the sticky behaviour shows only when a later landing of the same search fails that condition.
path to resolution: a constructed state test (or a shots scenario) that reaches two such landings in one search, the second failing the strict condition

description: [phase 3.8 38f, kind `harness`] On 2026-10-20 LIVING-PC's commit charge reached its limit (63.8 of 68.6 GB committed; the processes' private bytes summed to 24.7 GB, paged pool 7.1 GB): Frida capture / trace runners failed with MemoryError (course_season_6y c_c twice, the trace once), Lib.exe exited 1102 in a build and Git Bash failed to fork. The rest of the commit was not attributed to a process; pagefile-backed shared sections (Python mmap(-1, ..., tagname), as port/test/lib32.py's State32 makes one of 3.6 MB per state) count there and not in a process's private bytes.
path to resolution: find the holder of the unattributed commit (Sysinternals RAMMap / VMMap on the largest python.exe); close State32 mappings in long test sessions
